answer: Because the tundra salt is published after the ferrous checkpoint, the falcon audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 248 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 60 keys as a result pays for 60 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
